rules.cellCoverage: Clip actual convex UV face polygon against each integer unit cell; positive area only. Sum equals polygon area. Touching a cell boundary alone is excluded.
rules.fullSingleFaceCandidate: Exactly one positive-area cell and polygon covers unit area within1e-6; this is geometric coverage, not a confirmed whole-window instance.
rules.adjacency: Same model, side-adjusted plane and S/T basis/offset phase modulo64x256. Positive shared boundary length required, exact vertex-pair or collinear segment overlap; point contact excluded.
rules.unionCoverage: Canonical phase removes whole-cell offset translations. Group clipped face pieces are checked for positive-area pair overlap before summing. Full-cell union coverage still does not prove visible/semantic windows.

limits: No visibility, camera playback, screen area, lighting, occlusion, entity-instance transforms or runtime acceptance measured.
One BSP face can cover part, all or several repeated texture cells. No BSP face equals one window by definition.
UV bounding-box cell count is not used as confirmed coverage or a confirmed window count.
Mapping groups do not merge rotated/mirrored/different-basis parameterizations. Group coverage is compiled geometric evidence only.
Submodel entity references are retained, but this audit does not expand entity instances or transform geometry into runtime positions.
No app/engine/asset/model/Git/build changes or model call performed.
